scope: A disposable Kubernetes v1.36.1 kind cluster writes one actual Metadata-level audit event for a case-owned synthetic ConfigMap create. A digest-pinned Versity v1.9.0 S3 gateway stores the event on a case-owned PVC dynamically provisioned by Kind's local-path provisioner. Repeated Jobs run the same checker against measured GetObjectLockConfiguration responses for missing, below-minimum, and corrected synthetic retention policies; the passing state also checks the retrieved GetObjectRetention applied to the stored audit event. No legal schedule is selected. This does not establish a production audit export path, deployed fleet coverage, provider behavior, long-term durability, or retention administration controls.

checks.claim: The Versity S3 gateway is ready on a bound Kind local-path PVC
The checker detects a missing default retention period from the live bucket response
The checker detects a measured policy below the configured synthetic minimum
The same checker accepts the measured corrected policy and its applied audit object
The corrected bucket default governs new versions and the checker still flags the earlier version
